name: llmlint-e2e
//: The binary journeys: the real freshly built llmlint against the mock fixture. Depends on exactly what it drives (the crate, which owns the repo-root files the journeys read, such as README.md, and the fixture), and no project depends on it but the coverage aggregate and the workspace checks, which depend on every project.

test.//: dependsOn both builds, so a broken binary or fixture fails here, named, before any journey runs, and an uninstrumented run (LLMLINT_COVERAGE=off, the cross jobs) drives exactly what they built. Under coverage the journeys drive the instrumented copies coverage.sh builds, so their lines count toward coverage:coverage. Uncached for the same reason as llmlint:test.
